// ---------- Демонстрационная программа ----------
static final String DEMO = String.join("\n", "print \"=== MiniLang demo ===\";", "", "// Рекурсия и списки", "fun fib(n) {", "  if (n < 2) return n;", "  return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2);", "}", "var fibs = [];", "for (var i = 0; i < 15; i += 1) push(fibs, fib(i));", "print \"fib: \" + fibs;", "print \"последний: \" + fibs[-1] + \", всего: \" + len(fibs);", "", "// Замыкания", "fun makeCounter() {", "  var count = 0;", "  return fun() { count += 1; return count; };", "}", "var counter = makeCounter();", "counter(); counter();", "print \"счётчик: \" + counter();", "", "// Функции высшего порядка", "var squares = map(range(1, 11), fun(x) { return x * x; });", "var evens = filter(squares, fun(x) { return x % 2 == 0; });", "var total = reduce(evens, fun(acc, x) { return acc + x; }, 0);", "print \"квадраты: \" + squares;", "print \"чётные: \" + evens + \", сумма = \" + total;", "", "// Сортировка пузырьком", "fun bubble(xs) {", "  var a = xs + [];", "  var n = len(a);", "  var swapped = true;", "  while (swapped) {", "    swapped = false;", "    for (var i = 1; i < n; i += 1) {", "      if (a[i - 1] > a[i]) {", "        var t = a[i - 1]; a[i - 1] = a[i]; a[i] = t;", "        swapped = true;", "      }", "    }", "    n -= 1;", "  }", "  return a;", "}", "print bubble([5, 3, 9, 1, 4, 8, 2]);", "", "// Строки", "var words = split(\"the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog\", \" \");", "print join(sort(words), \", \");", "print upper(\"mini\") + lower(\"LANG\") + \" \" + \"=\" * 10;", "print \"=== готово ===\";");
